name: Entity Reference Current Language
description: provides an entity-reference selection plugin that filters selectable candidates by the current language.
project_description:
The Entity Reference Current Language module provides a selection plugin for entity reference fields that filters selectable candidates by the current site language. It simplifies content management in multilingual Drupal sites by ensuring referenced content matches the language of the current page.

 Features 
 
 Filters entity reference field candidates by current language 
 Compatible with all entity reference widgets 
 Configurable on a per-field basis via a checkbox 
 Enhances multilingual content management 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10.x or 11.x 
 Core Language module enabled
